lines: Dell's role is growing: he played 47% of snaps over the last 3 games, up from 41% on the season, and has played 4 of 10 games.
He saw 5.7 targets per game over the last 3 games, a 17% share of team targets, and averaged 10.4 PPR points.
Week 12 is against BAL, which allows the 17th-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said Dell is back as an impact playmaker.
